fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The `/metagame` grid only offered a single "Quality" sort option based on the Wilson score lower confidence interval at 99% confidence. Users had no way to explore archetypes sorted by a more lenient quality metric (favouring newer/smaller archetypes) or a stricter one (only well-established archetypes), nor by theoretical upside potential.

## What changed

**`decksite/data/clauses.py`**
- Added `wilson_upper_bound_sql()` — mirrors `wilson_lower_bound_sql()` but uses `+` instead of `-` in front of the square-root term, giving the upper Wilson confidence bound.
- Added three entries to `sort_options` in `archetype_order_by()`:
  - `qualityOptimistic` — Wilson lower bound at 50% confidence (benefits archetypes with fewer matches).
  - `qualityStrict` — Wilson lower bound at 99.999% confidence (only very well-established archetypes rank highly).
  - `potential` — Wilson upper bound at default 99% confidence (ranks by upside / potential ceiling).

**`shared_web/static/js/metagamegrid.jsx`**
- Added three `<option>` elements matching the new backend sort keys: `Quality (Optimistic)`, `Quality (Strict)`, and `Potential`.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all checks passed).
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 845 passed, 1 skipped (unrelated), 89 deselected in 18.5s.

Fixes #12578
